# Reflectivity patching gauntlet (synthetic)

Generated by `tests/tools/ref_patch_gauntlet.py --design all` (400 replicates per designed condition, 60 per random one). A join passes when |mean pull| < 0.2, pull SD is within 0.90–1.15 and no fit failed (hand-off 08); random conditions, with fewer replicates, are allowed two standard errors. Per-point errors: counting+monitor; monitor: real. Conditions not judged (information only): edge_staggered.
